clips.title: The story
paras: Welcome to Shen'dar Village introduces travelers to the key figures and local dynamics of Shen'dar Village. Upon arrival, newcomers are directed to consult the local Windshaper elder and the village innkeeper before assisting with pressing threats like regional bandits.

Arriving in Shen'dar Village, travelers are encouraged to familiarize themselves with the settlement's key residents before taking on local tasks. Newcomers exhibiting spirit-touched qualities are directed to meet with Elder Illaya Amberwind near the village square, as well as Coriella Calmbreeze at the village inn for lodging and supplies. This greeting ensures visitors understand the settlement's delicate social dynamics before taking up arms.

Beneath the quiet exterior of Shen'dar Village lies political friction between the spirit-attuned Windshapers and the High Order. Although ideological disputes between the two factions run hot across the region, residents in Shen'dar keep their disagreements civil. Both groups recognize that petty squabbles must take a backseat to pressing survival matters, not least of which is an encroaching bandit menace threatening the area.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.
Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.
Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.
